title: The Nine as a psychological warfare experiment

tellings.quote: start around that time, too, with this idea that it was a side op, or that it was this early psychological warfare experiment where can we get,

plain: The Nine, a supposed council of alien beings that a group at the Round Table Foundation in Maine claimed to contact in the 1950s, may have been a side operation or an early psychological warfare experiment rather than real contact. The researcher Greg Malatzi raises this idea, linking it to the writer Peter Levenda. If true, it would mean the messages were a test of what people could be made to believe.
